You are an expert in analyzing logs of test execution script and dockerfile construction.  
Your task is to verify whether the target tests have been executed correctly and, if not, diagnose the issues.
Background: To run the target test files of a given repository, we create a Dockerfile and an eval script. We plan to invoke the eval script inside the container built by that Dockerfile.

You will:
1. Analyze the log of test execution to check if the target tests were executed and whether they passed.
2. If the tests did not run correctly, determine whether the issue is related to:
   - The **Dockerfile** (environment setup issues)
   - The **evaluation script** (test execution issues)
   - Missing information that needs to be collected

3. Based on your analysis, provide **clear guidance** to the appropriate agent:
   - `write_dockerfile_agent`
   - `write_eval_script_agent`
   - `context_retrieval_agent`

Your findings and recommendations must be structured in a JSON format, ensuring efficient collaboration with other agents.

Target repository name: ValueCell-ai/valuecell
Commit SHA: a1ee111f912c54fb0678b608b98c47f5f8d17942
Version: 0.1
Target test files:
python/valuecell/adapters/assets/tests/test_dashscope_provider.py

The current dockerfile used to setup environemnt:
# Use Ubuntu 22.04 as the base image for bash compatibility and stability
FROM --platform=linux/x86_64 ubuntu:22.04
ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
ENV TZ=Etc/UTC
SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-c"]

# Install essential system dependencies, including git, curl, wget, unzip, and build tools
# Use Python 3.10 (default in Ubuntu 22.04) instead of 3.12 as 3.12 packages are unavailable in Ubuntu 22.04 repos
RUN apt update && apt install -y \
    git \
    curl \
    wget \
    unzip \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    python3.10 \
    python3.10-venv \
    python3.10-distutils \
    python3-pip \
    locales \
    locales-all \
    tzdata \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Make python3.10 the default python3
RUN update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/python3 python3 /usr/bin/python3.10 1

# Upgrade pip and install uv package manager using python3
RUN python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel \
    && python3 -m pip install uv

# Install bun (frontend package manager) - install via official bun install script
RUN curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash \
    && mv /root/.bun/bin/bun /usr/local/bin/bun

# Set locale and timezone
ENV LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8

# Clone the target repo and checkout the specific commit, then set up the environment
WORKDIR /testbed/
RUN git clone https://github.com/ValueCell-ai/valuecell.git /testbed \
    && git checkout a1ee111f912c54fb0678b608b98c47f5f8d17942 \
    && chmod -R 777 /testbed

# Copy .env.example to .env from the root directory as per repository setup notes
RUN cp /testbed/.env.example /testbed/.env

# Backend dependencies installation using uv package manager in the python folder with extra dev
RUN cd /testbed/python \
    && uv sync --extra dev

# Install the backend python package itself in editable mode including dev extras (alternative to uv sync)
RUN cd /testbed/python && uv pip install --editable ".[dev]"

# Frontend dependencies installation using bun in the frontend directory
RUN cd /testbed/frontend && bun install

# Expose environment variables related to python path and bun (optional for convenience)
ENV PATH="/root/.bun/bin:$PATH"

# The container is now ready with python 3.10, uv, bun, all repo dependencies installed, with code checked out at the specified commit.
# Test execution will be handled outside of the Dockerfile.

# Set default working directory
WORKDIR /testbed/

The current eval script (omit test patch to decrease length) used to run tests:
#!/bin/bash
set -uxo pipefail
cd /testbed
git checkout a1ee111f912c54fb0678b608b98c47f5f8d17942 

# Apply the test patch before running the tests
git apply -v - <<'EOF_114329324912'
[CONTENT OF TEST PATCH]
EOF_114329324912

# Run only the specified target test file with uv run pytest
uv run pytest --no-header -rA --tb=short python/valuecell/adapters/assets/tests/test_dashscope_provider.py

rc=$?            # Save exit code
 
echo "OMNIGRIL_EXIT_CODE=$rc" # Echo test status

# Reset the patched test file to avoid side effects
git checkout a1ee111f912c54fb0678b608b98c47f5f8d17942 python/valuecell/adapters/assets/tests/test_dashscope_provider.py
